title: Olivia Dean, Limp Bizkit, KATSEYE Among Headliners For Lollapalooza India 2027
summary: The fifth edition of the festival will take place at the Mahalaxmi Race Course in Mumbai on Jan. 23-24.
contentText:
The lineup for the fifth edition of Lollapalooza India dropped on Thursday morning (Sept. 3) and it features headliners Olivia Dean , Limp Bizkit , KATSEYE and Fontaines D.C. The two-day event that will take over the Mahalaxmi Race Course in Mumbai on Jan. 23-24 will also include sets from 5 Seconds of Summer, St. Vincent, Steve Angello, Rachel Chinoriri, Ecca Vandal and ¥ØU$UK€ ¥UK1MAT$U.

The gig will mark the debut in India for all four headliners, who will take the stage alongside a stacked lineup of beloved Indian acts including Anuv Jain, Indian Ocean, Kayan and Scribe, as well as former Police drummer Stewart Copeland with Indian composer Ricky Kej, with whom he’s collaborated on a series of world music and new age projects.

Among the other acts on the lineup are: Aditya Gadhvi, The Manganiyar Seduction, 2ManyDJS, Zulan, Blackstratblues, Reha Raj, Pinkshift, Eleven guitarist Alain Johannes, Maneesh on the Beat, Isyana Sarasvati, Ranj x Clifr, Swadesi, Yashraj and Donn Bhat and others.

KATSEYE are in the midst of their first-ever world arena outing, The Wildwood Tour, which kicked off on Sept. 1 at 3Arena in Dublin and will keep them on the road through a Nov. 28 date in Mexico City. At present, two members of the group, Manon and Sophia, are on a temporary hiatus to focus on their health. In addition, the group was forced to cancel their planned appearance at Olivia Rodrigo’s Daisy Chain Fields Festival last weekend after member Megan sprained her ankle .

Last year’s Lolla India featured sets from Linkin Park, Playboi Carti, Yungblud, Kehlani, LANY, Calum Scott, Destroy Lonely, Karsh Kale, Fujii Kaze, Sammy Virji, Mother Mother and more.
